asset.name: UIProvider
asset.description: The single composition root that resolves theme, locale, direction, motion policy, density, portal host, interaction modality, and telemetry, and supplies them to every descendant through one stable boundary.

requires.reason: Supplies the active token set to descendants.
Resolves and switches the active theme.
Reads platform capabilities to seed motion policy and interaction modality.

rationale: Its absence is the highest-value adoption-scanner finding: components appear to work while silently losing theming, direction, and motion policy.
